registered_secondary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in the KCCQ Total Symptom Score at 8 Months
registered_secondary_outcomes.description: KCCQ is a 23-item, self-administered instrument that quantifies physical function, symptoms (frequency, severity and recent change), social function, self-efficacy and knowledge, and quality of life. The KCCQ Total Symptom Score incorporates the symptom domains into a single score. Scores are transformed to a range of 0-100, in which higher scores reflect better health status.
